an3.119:1.5: Idha bhikkhave ekacco pāṇātipātī hoti . . . pe (115.1) . . . samphappalāpī hoti.
an3.119:2.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco micchā-ājīvo hoti micchāājīvena jīvikaṃ kappeti.
an3.119:3.3: -n' atthi dinnaṃ, n' atthi yiṭṭhaṃ . . . pe (115.3) . . . ye imañ ca lokaṃ parañ ca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedenti.
an3.119:3.5: Imā kho bhikkhave tisso vipattiyo ti. 4.
an3.119:4.5: Idha bhikkhave ekacco pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti . . . pe (115.5) . . . samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti.
an3.119:5.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco sammā-ājīvo hoti sammāājīvena jīvikaṃ kappeti.
an3.119:6.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco sammādiṭṭhiko hoti aviparītadassano --
an3.119:6.3: atthi dinnaṃ, atthi yiṭṭhaṃ . . . pe (115.7) . . . ye imañ ca lokaṃ parañ ca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedenti.
an3.119:6.5: Imā kho bhikkhave tisso sampadā. 118. Tīṇ'
